4479752309,Membership Operations Specialist,Mixue Group,Mixue Group,,Posted Today,,,"New York, United States",1,"New York, United States",false,,United States,,0,"About the Role
We are looking for an Membership Operations Specialist to support the development, operation, and continuous optimization of our membership program in the U.S. market.

This role will focus on membership growth, CRM operations, customer engagement, marketing campaigns, data analysis, and store execution . The ideal candidate can develop operational strategies while also driving execution across stores and cross-functional teams.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, operate, and continuously optimize the U.S. membership program, including registration, points, membership tiers, benefits, coupons, stored value, and referral programs
Develop and execute membership growth strategies, including customer acquisition, new customer conversion, repeat purchase, inactive member reactivation, and member win-back initiatives
Segment members based on purchase frequency, spending, purchase preferences, and engagement, and develop targeted strategies for different customer segments
Plan and execute membership campaigns such as Member Days, points redemption programs, birthday benefits, new product trials, limited-time offers, and holiday campaigns
Manage customer engagement channels such as SMS, email, and app push notifications, including audience targeting, content, frequency, and performance optimization

Monitor and analyze key membership and marketing metrics, including member growth, registration conversion, engagement, repeat purchase rate, average order value, member sales contribution, coupon redemption rate, and campaign ROI
Support CRM, CDP, membership platform, and marketing automation initiatives, including requirements gathering, functional testing, and user acceptance testing
Work closely with U.S. stores and cross-functional teams to implement membership campaigns and operational initiatives at the store level
Collect customer and store feedback and translate insights into actionable improvements
Continuously optimize membership and customer engagement strategies based on regional, store-level, and consumer behavior differences.
Qualifications
2–4 years of experience in membership operations, customer/user operations, CRM, loyalty programs, or a related field
Experience in food & beverage, coffee, tea & beverage, retail, consumer products, or other consumer-facing industries is preferred
Hands-on experience with membership programs, customer growth, customer segmentation, marketing campaigns, or retention/repurchase initiatives
Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to evaluate operational performance and identify opportunities for improvement
Experience with CRM, CDP, loyalty platforms, or marketing automation tools is preferred
Experience with system requirements, functional testing, or user acceptance testing is a plus
Strong execution and project management skills, with the ability to move initiatives from planning to implementation
Understanding of U.S. consumer behavior, holidays, and applicable customer privacy considerations
Strong English communication skills, with the ability to independently communicate with stores, vendors, and technology service providers
Bilingual in Chinese and English
What We're Looking For
Strong sensitivity to data and consumer behavior
Structured thinking and strong problem-solving skills
A hands-on approach—you enjoy both developing strategies and driving execution
Strong cross-functional communication and project coordination skills
An understanding of the U.S. retail and/or food & beverage consumer market
A proactive mindset with strong ownership and attention to detail.",3621,https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4479752309,,,,,,,not_checked,,2026-10-15,,2026-10-26,,,,true,0,,,,,,,,,,,,,,
